title: Shared Identifiers
description: ASINs and ISBNs that more than one book in a library holds, where those books aren't the same work. This usually means a bundle's or another volume's identifier was copied onto the wrong book. Apps that sync with Trove treat a shared identifier as another copy of the same book, so these books get merged there.
repairHelp: The dry run asks Amazon which book really owns each identifier, and changes nothing. Applying clears the identifier from the other books and then re-fetches their metadata, so they pick up their own. Groups Amazon can't settle are left alone for you to fix by hand.
